name: Python Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main", "v**"]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: tests-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash -eux {0}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:

  static:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Python tooling
        uses: mongodb-labs/drivers-github-tools/python/setup@99b1cbd729bc83bf7fc74e1b2a97fffad3d65d7b  # v3.1.1
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
      # Runs before the install so a stale lock fails in seconds rather than
      # after the build and typecheck.
      - name: Check lockfile is up to date
        run: |
          uv lock --check
      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          just install
      - name: Run linters
        run: |
          just lint-manual
      - name: Run compilation
        run: |
          export PYMONGO_C_EXT_MUST_BUILD=1
          pip install -v -e .
          python tools/fail_if_no_c.py
      - name: Run typecheck
        run: |
          just typing
      - name: Run synchro smoke test
        run: |
          uv run --extra test --with unasync pytest tools/test_synchro.py -v --override-ini="addopts="
      - name: Validate pyproject.toml
        run: |
          uvx --from 'validate-pyproject[all]' validate-pyproject pyproject.toml
      - name: Check package metadata
        run: |
          uv build
          uvx twine check --strict dist/*
      - run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y cppcheck
      - run: |
          cppcheck --force bson
          cppcheck pymongo

  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Tests currently only pass on ubuntu on GitHub Actions.
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        python-version: ["3.11", "3.13t", "3.15"]
        mongodb-version: ["8.0"]

    name: Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Python tooling
        uses: mongodb-labs/drivers-github-tools/python/setup@99b1cbd729bc83bf7fc74e1b2a97fffad3d65d7b  # v3.1.1
        with:
          # The beta Python here relies on the action's prerelease default.
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      - id: setup-mongodb
        uses: mongodb-labs/drivers-evergreen-tools@5d52ccdbb60f6e1749a71ce787c9f8f7da861b15 # v1.6.0
        with:
          version: "${{ matrix.mongodb-version }}"
      - name: Run tests
        run: uv run --extra test pytest -v

    # This enables a coverage report for a given PR, which will be augmented by
    # the combined codecov report uploaded in Evergreen.
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    name: Coverage
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: true
      - name: Install Python tooling
        uses: mongodb-labs/drivers-github-tools/python/setup@99b1cbd729bc83bf7fc74e1b2a97fffad3d65d7b  # v3.1.1

        with:
          version: "8.0"

        run: COVERAGE=1 just setup-tests

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
